TPPROFED05 – MANAGING THE LEARNING ENVIRONMENT

PNU Philosophy PNU Vision PNU Mission PNU Quality Policy

College/Institute Goals
Program Outcomes

Education for personal renewal and social transformation.
A leading future-ready education university responsive to national and global development goals and directions
Philippine Normal University is committed to lead innovative, responsive and sustainable teacher education programs that set the standards of future-ready teachers and education leaders. As the National Center for Teacher Education, the Philippine Normal University commits to provide inclusive, innovative, impactful, and sustainable teacher education programs that produce future-ready teachers and education leaders imbued with the values of truth, excellence, and service. Furthermore, PNU shall ensure the continual improvement of its Quality Management System through compliance with International Quality Standards and statutory and regulatory requirements. PNU shall achieve these commitments through its core functions of instruction, research, extension, and production. Digitally Literate and Data-Driven Decision Maker Design Thinker and Innovator Discerning and Compassionate Person Dynamic Lifelong Learner and Leader Deeply Rooted Global Citizen
The College of Teacher Development (CTD) is committed to champion quality teacher education in the country. It is dedicated to: 1. Provide future-ready teacher development through innovative, inclusive and quality-assured academic programs. 2. Lead in advancing teacher education research and translating scholarly work into relevant policies and practices that benefit education and communities. 3. Establish CTD as leader in producing impactful educational resources, and programs. 4. Establish a robust international presence through strategic collaborations, advancing the College’s leadership in teacher education. 5. Maintain a pool of faculty experts who lead as influential public intellectuals in education and related disciplines. 6. Established well-defined systems-based solutions and sustainability practices to ensure efficiency and effectiveness of implementation of CTD Programs and procedures.
1. Apply knowledge of educational philosophy and theories, current research in education, and professional ethics in teaching and learning practices critically. 2. Engage in reflective practice guided by the core values of effective teachers and continual professional learning, to promote positive societal transformation,
and respond to the needs of an ever-changing world.

PPST Domain 2: Learning Environment, Strands 1-6

TPROFED05 Managing the Learning Environment
TPROFED01, TPROFED02, TPROFED03, TPROFED04 This course equips pre-service teachers with knowledge and strategies to design learning environments that optimize learning through classroom structures and activities that enhance learner engagement, self-regulation and motivation. Students explore best practices in promoting purposive learning, supporting academic achievement, nurturing and respecting diversity in varied learning contexts. They study the teacher’s role in creating positive learning environments that foster lifelong learning; managing discipline problems, interpersonal conflicts; and cultivating a safe, secure, fair, respectful, caring and inclusive learning climate. It emphasizes socio-emotional learning and inculcates empathy, human-centered problem-solving, compassion for others, honor, and effective leadership as critical values to integrate in a learning environment. They develop a comprehensive Learning Environment Management Plan (LEMP) to guide them in building a favorable environment to facilitate effective learning.

PNU is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive academic environment for students from various backgrounds, including those with disabilities, exceptionalities, ethnic and linguistic differences, religious affiliations, gender identities, and other individual differences. The University ensures its commitment to equal access, participation, and engagement with educational opportunities that supports our academic culture and values as well as celebrate diversity and inclusivity. If you have any physical or psychological/ mental health conditions or challenges which can affect your performance in class, you are encouraged to inform me. This is to ensure that we are creating and fostering a responsive classroom environment. You are also encouraged to avail of the services of the following offices regarding your challenge/ condition: - Student Affairs and Services Office: counselingservices@pnu.edu.ph - University Health Services Unit: uhsu@pnu.edu.ph - Gender, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusivity Office: gedio@pnu.edu.ph

CLASS POLICIES

Attendance and Class Participation • Complete attendance and active class participation are highly encouraged. They indicate interest,
commitment to learn and sense of responsibility. Attendance is part of the final grade. • Absence must be valid and supported by appropriate permission letter and other essential documents i.e., doctors’ certification. • Use the appropriate communication channels provided in class e.g., in-person, GC, GMeet. Behavior • Apply rules of etiquette for in-person and online interactions and general behavior.
ensure proper decorum, respect, inclusivity and use of courteous language. • Be guided by the code of conduct expected of professional teachers. • Use mobile devices only when necessary or allowed in class. Dress Code • Follow university guidelines for wearing of uniform and wash day clothing i.e., ensure that
you command respect and project decency as well as professionalism. • Follow university guidelines for hair color and accessories. Ensure they are not distracting, rather
serve the purpose of enhancing your look in a professional manner.

Course Expectations • Sign and demonstrate understanding of the Honor Code and PNU Students’ Blended Learning Undertaking. • Read the course guidelines, references and supplementary materials, view the videos on the weekly topics and accomplish the individual,
small group and large class activities religiously. • Follow instructions carefully. Ask for clarification if needed. • Submit outputs on time and monitor one’s completion of weekly outputs. • Report technical problems encountered and other important concerns. • Practice ethical behavior especially in completing course activities, avoiding plagiarism.
